blocks.text: Tkinter provides many components, called widgets, that help build interactive graphical applications. A program can contain multiple visual elements such as windows, frames, buttons, and text fields. These widgets allow users to enter data, choose options, or perform actions. Each widget has its own purpose, and combining them creates a complete interface. Tkinter also supports layout management, so widgets can be arranged neatly on the screen.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Create a main window and divide it into two frames. Add different widgets in each frame to organize layout.
